title: Inspect and extend: Reports contain expenses, not just totals
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/model.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve expense and report types, seed records, and derived totals.
problem: A report is a folder containing expense rows. Read the typed shapes and seed data, then see how a displayed total should be derived from the rows rather than typed separately. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/model.ts` and the related project files: src/model.ts; src/data.ts; src/screens/ReportsScreen.tsx.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to expense and report types, seed records, and derived totals.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Seed reports and the CAD profile are demo data; no accounting backend is connected.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A report is a folder containing expense rows. Read the typed shapes and seed data, then see how a displayed total should be derived from the rows rather than typed separately.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/model.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
